scope: Validate workspace browsing and file-collection paths against engine UTF-8 byte/control limits, and associate editable inline errors with the directory input.

regression.result: Six failed and forty passed across forty-six tests in two files. Regressions covered oversized Unicode paths accepted by the desktop, C1 controls accepted by the desktop, and missing byte-limit feedback. The exact 1,024-byte accepted boundary and existing file operations remained passing.
regression.queue_submission: The detached command reported a delayed receipt, then produced baseline job ee0860386628. The receipt was recovered without submitting duplicate work; this was not a test failure.

implementation: Apply the 1,024-byte limit using UTF-8 encoding before a workspace request; preserve the existing separator normalization and meaningful filename spaces.
Reject C0, DEL and C1 control characters, backslashes and dot/parent segments while retaining legitimate Unicode directory names.
Keep invalid addresses editable and connect the inline alert to the field with aria-describedby. Clear the error when the user corrects the path.

verification.checks: Root/E2E types, lint, Electron/renderer builds, path/file-panel units, copied Rust contract and both existing native workspace theme flows with zero retries or accessibility violations.
verification.native_method: Owned Electron profiles and the authenticated local HTTP engine fixture. Invalid Unicode-byte and C1 paths retain their input and accessible errors without issuing workspace requests. Corrected paths then navigate through the production native bridge. Engine responses are simulated.

engine_contract.qualification: Bundled production desktop parser compared with the exact copied Rust workspace_path function. Accepted inputs are checked using the normalized path actually sent; rejected inputs use the original string. This validates path rules, not filesystem access, Temporal execution or a live backend.

source_guard.qualification: Manual hashes sealed after lint/format preparation and compared after checks; not an immutable queue snapshot.

verification.full_validation: Pending exact-head CI after normal-hook commit and push; parent CI does not qualify this change.

limitations: Path-predicate agreement does not prove filesystem access or live engine/Temporal/sandbox/NSR execution. A designated CHAT_TEST workspace is still required.
No version/tag/release or update publication; v1.1.19 unchanged.
